items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Connie had a stroke on the day we were supposed to go to Boston and play with these old instruments of this Bach Brandenburg Concerto... Hogwood said why don’t we do it without the drums, and we did.

ctx.x: Wasn’t Connie Kay sick? Connie had a stroke first and then didn’t Mickey come in?

That was during the year that Mickey replaced Connie. He made most of the record date there with MJQ and Friends, and Connie was recovering, and he was up there. Connie had a stroke on the day we were supposed to go to Boston and play with these old instruments of this Bach Brandenburg Concerto and we had learned all this stuff in the odd keys because they played these ancient instruments which were in different keys from what were used to, Hogwood.
